profile.headline: Mathematics Educator and Space Software Developer at South Side Area Home
profile.jobTitle: Mathematics Educator and Space Software Developer
profile.summary:
My professional experience is as a Software Systems Developer and Mathematics Educator. As chairman of the Software Architecture Review Board for Onboard Shuttle(IBM, LORAL, LMT and USA) for 17 years and having served on the AIAA International Standards committee I have done extensive work in designing, coding and testing software as well as writing aerospace and astronautics standards for man-rated flight applications. I developed capabilities in Guidance Navigation and Flight Control for the Space Shuttle program and am an Associate Fellow in the AIAA. I currently serve on the Int'l AIAA Software technical committee specifically on the Standards and Reuse subcommittees. I would like to do some public relations work in space (public relations, lecturing, publications) and to return to sharing my experience on a space project.with young aspiring minds. As a Mathematics instructor, I have taught in college and high school for ten years.I recently taught mathematics in a Catholic Middle School and coached the math competition team to a second place finish in a forty school competition. I wish to do future work in state education on Standards and motivational work in STEM career advancement.

Specialties: Mathematical Logic,Software Architecture,Classical Mathematics and Advanced Space Applications.

positions.title: Mathematics Educator and Space Software Developer
Mathematics Teacher
positions.description: I taught all 7th and 8th grade students including honor classes. I also coached the mathematics competition team to a second place finish in a forty school tournament.

positions.title: Computer Science Staff
positions.description: I have worked Onboard Shuttle designing, coding and testing the programs in the four primary General Purpose Computers(GPCs) that control all functions of the Shuttle. I was Chairman of the Software Architecture Review Board for 17 years which was the  overseer for Shuttle project changes in the use of computer programming practices and use of GPC compiler,memory allocations and linkage editor. I primarily worked in Guidance, Navigation and Flight Control (GNC) including IMUs(gyros), Uplink from the ground, ICC between computers(like SM to GNC or GNC to BFS), Execs which dispatched procedures (with proper load-balancing) and scheduled programs throughout GNC. Originally, the space shuttle flight software was developed under IBM(1981-1994), then LORAL Space Information Systems(1994-1996) then Lockheed Martin Space Systems(1996-1998) and now United Space Alliance, PASS FSW(1998-2011).

positions.title: Engineering Methods
positions.description: I have worked on many engineering techniques, methods and architectures. I have worked language comparison techniques, feature conversion methods, OO coaching techniques and technology insertion methods. In 1992-1993, I worked on REAP which was a reverse engineering method developed in coordination with NASA. I  presented a demo showing an object orientated navigator on an automated software environment navigating from object to object and transitioning out of the database into another language other than the one originally imported from. I have worked object orientated design methods throughout the project processes. I have taught many classes on Standards, CPU, I/O, Executives, error prevention, Quaternions, class development, Architecture and Executives.

positions.title: Mathematics Teacher
positions.description: I was a high school mathematics instructor 9-12(all levels) for ten years. I helped coach Mathletes for competition. I was a member of the National and State Education Associations during this time period. I have also tutored students in many community programs throughout the years.

positions.title: Associate Fellow & Int'l Standards Committee Member
positions.description: I helped to develop the AIAA CPSRS International Standards for Software for two and a half years. I read standards and classified them according to certain criteria with a final rating of preferred or not. If preferred then it would qualify  for possible inclusion in the CPSRS(Collection of Preferred Space Related Standards). My experience with Standards(Chairman of the Shuttle PASS FSW Standards Board) served me well for this duty. AIAA reviewed my qualifications in 2003 for promotion to Associate Fellow Grade.

positions.title: Staff Programmer
positions.description: I worked Onboard Shuttle capabilities development. On the Space Shuttle Primary Flight Software Process Team, I did management and technical support for Shuttle Flight Software system enhancements for Space Station and Global Positioning System. On the Shuttle GPS Mode Team, I worked requirements and implemented parts of the Shuttle Operational Navigation capability utilizing the Global Poaitioning System. I also contributed to the Phase 1 Shuttle-Mir program development during this time period.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: I worked Onboard Shuttle capabilities development. I received the Silver Snoopy Award from NASA astronauts as a personal achievement award for the IMU Align capability which I was Lead Developer on. IMU Align changed the gyros calculations for Shuttle positioning in all memory configurations involving 197 reviews in one year(1990 in IBM Federal Systems).I also became an ISO9001 Internal auditor during this timeframe.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: I did major design, development and testing on Hubble telescope, SSE, SIGI, CAU, Centaur, Galileo, single string GPS, triple string GPS, Single Engine Out, Two Engine Out, Three Engine Out, Trans-Atlantic Abort(TAL), East Coast Abort landing,  Multifunction Electronic Display Subsystem (MEDS), Bearing Display, Leap Year algorithms and other capabilities implemented on 20+ OI systems. Each OI was planned to fly 4 to 12 Shuttle flights off of it. I was build coordinator for 12 years  including dataset migration into the NASA Red Room( DOD flights) for all corporations.

positions.title: Mathematics Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was employed on a Teaching Assistantship to teach Calculus at Iowa State University. I also participated in an Honors Student project known as "French House" where I lived during that year and only French was spoken in the house. I was a mathematics consultant in a plasma physics group doing experimental work which was later reviewed by Edward Teller.

educations.fieldOfStudy: MS(Educ.) with Honors, Mathematics(Logic)-Major on BS, Education(Statistics & Needs Models)-Major on MS.
